persona.persona: A round cream cloud lamb who is happy with one small comfort fix.
do: Show one small comfort change at a time.
Keep the forehead coil and low tan ears visible.
Give her warm, uncluttered home settings.
avoid: Piling on several accessories at once.
Hiding the peach face or short brown hooves.
Turning comfort into a health or air claim.
persona.preserve: Round cream cloud-like lamb with a forehead coil, low tan ears, peach face and short brown hooves.

costumes.name: Summer Light Neckerchief
costumes.note: A thin neckerchief below the chin that keeps her round shape intact.

costumes.name: Winter Light Scarf
costumes.note: A short, light scarf that stays clear of the face and ears.

costumes.name: Halloween Orange Cape
costumes.note: A small orange cape behind her, with the forehead coil fully visible.

costumes.name: Holiday Bow
costumes.note: A small bow at the neck, away from the forehead coil.
